title: One scroll implementation (MenuScrollBox/MenuScrollBar) for Terminal, InfoPane, ShaderCodePane, MenuBox and the graph view; one tool panel for controls and tool info
description:
Repo plan merges 3E.23-24. Scrolling is implemented six ways: MenuScrollBar/MenuScrollBox (the newest, pixel-accurate, generalised in DSL-48) plus hand-rolled scrollOffsetY/onScroll in Terminal (~88), InfoPane (~11, 55-63), ShaderCodePane (~44, 351), MenuBox (~36) and DslGraphView. Use MenuScrollBox/MenuScrollBar everywhere, keeping Terminal's snap-to-prompt. After the tool merge, InfoPane's tool text and the ctrl+I Controls box show the same thing: one panel listing the active tool's controls and info.

Rulings that apply (user, 2026-10-17): no class renames where avoidable (classes move package and keep their names; Camera stays the parent of Camera2D/Camera3D; MeshNode keeps its name); scenes and tools keep declaring their controls in a method mapping keys to functions; Palettes is the colour class patch colours merge into. Full plan and evidence: $REPO_HOME/ai-workspace/reports/repo-plan-2026-10-17.md.
definition-of-done:
1. No hand-rolled scroll offset outside MenuScrollBox/MenuScrollBar.
2. Terminal still snaps to the prompt; touchpad horizontal and vertical scroll behave as in the graph view.
3. One tool panel in 2D and 3D scenes.
4. Launch entries and screenshots.
testing-plan:
1. Live: scroll each pane with wheel and touchpad.
2. mvn test.
changes-made: Terminal, InfoPane, ShaderCodePane each scroll in a MenuScrollBox (wheel/trackpad delta + scroll bar, framebuffer pixels); their hand-rolled scrollOffsetY/onScroll are gone. Terminal keeps snap-to-prompt via MenuScrollBox.scrollToEndPending.
Main menu MenuBox holds its scroll in a MenuScrollBar (ITEM_COLUMN_SCROLL_BAR) beside the item column: wheel and bar presses; item clicks unchanged.
PointerRegion.claimsPointer takes the press point, so pane boxes claim only presses on their bar and row clicks (focus, HyperString links, GLSL line clicks) keep their old path.
Boxes take the wheel only while their scene is active (and the scene terminal only while shown), so stale subscriptions no longer steal zoom.
HyperString.addHyperString keeps dynamic words dynamic (it cast them to String). ui-state reports every box's scroll, bar and rows, plus menuScroll.
Tests: PaneScrollBoxTest (1.25-scaled wheel, bar page, row press, hidden terminal, snap, dynamic copy); mvn test 557/0.
MenuScrollBox refits its bounds on every layout, so panes follow a window resize (the line scene's code pane kept its startup size).

Layouts in window pixels move to framebuffer pixels: MainScene's views and inView, TradeScene, the Scene tooltip, RoutePlanningTool's toolbar and KnotTool's hover; at 1.25 scale the editor no longer squeezes into the left 80% (master had this too).
Headless scenes render at a display scale, ixdar.headless.scale (default 1.25): a 1024 window gives a 1280 framebuffer, so window/framebuffer mix-ups show in agent screenshots.

claimsRows is gone: every box takes the presses over it and runs the clicked word itself; a box's optional click hook focuses its pane (terminal, info). The terminal's no-op calculateClick is removed. GLSL line clicks still preview (tmp/ui-8-glsl-line-click.png); mvn test 557/0.
review-summary: The Terminal, InfoPane, ShaderCodePane and main MenuBox now scroll through MenuScrollBox and MenuScrollBar, with wheel, trackpad and scroll-bar input in framebuffer pixels like the model menu. Each had its own hand-rolled offset that ignored trackpad magnitude and offered no scroll bar.
